comment.body: Thanks for the arrow-versus-Space comparison and the attached crash evidence. As @moooyo notes, #51583 is now merged and addresses initial arrow selection being applied to the preceding character list. Could you repeat your original arrow-activation workflow on a build confirmed to contain that change, and report the exact PowerToys version/build and whether Quick Accent still stops? A merged PR is not necessarily in your installed release, so please do not treat a retest of the same older build as testing the fix. No replacement ZIP is needed for this confirmation.

information_gaps.why_needed: The maintainer requests a retest, but no reporter result establishes recovery or whether their installed build includes the merged change.
information_gaps.information: Result of the original arrow-activation workload on a build containing #51583, with exact version/build
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Use a release or maintainer-provided build confirmed to contain #51583, repeat the original arrow-activation workflow, and report exact build and whether it still fails. No new archive is needed for this first confirmation.

issue_context.summary: The assigned maintainer now links merged Quick Accent fix #51583 and asks for a retest; the supplied crash evidence does not establish reporter recovery.
initial_investigation: Read the complete report, all three comments and timeline; compared the prior investigation with the new maintainer response.

Inspected the supplied archive event rather than relying only on the maintainer summary; read the complete current covering PR description and verified merged status. No local crash reproduction or release-inclusion test was performed.
inferences: The retained-list selection correction plausibly covers the reported arrow-trigger crash, but it does not prove that every hook removal or random stop is fixed.
known_information: The supplied report isolates arrow activation under CPU load on 0.102.2933; Space activation avoids the reported failure.
The supplied archive contains an October 22 Application Error for PowerToys.PowerAccent.exe 0.102.2933 in ucrtbase.dll, exception c0000409.
The November 3 maintainer reply explicitly links #51583 and asks the reporter to try again.

Live #51583 is merged as of October 27. Its description identifies initial selection against a retained, previous character list and defers selection until the current list is ready. This is more specific than the earlier unconfirmed ScrollIntoView hypothesis.
There is no subsequent reporter response confirming whether the original workload succeeds with a build containing that change.
issue_context.analysis: Route to the existing merged fix and the outstanding maintainer retest, not a competing UI-dispatch redesign. The original archive proves the older crash signature, not that every CPU-load-related non-response shares that cause. Confirm the exact tested version/build before treating this report as resolved.
